name: Customerly activation 1
request: Write exactly one English activation email from the Customerly team. Reader: A SaaS support lead who just opened a Customerly workspace and can edit their website. Ask them to do one thing: Set up live chat on their site. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.
target_market: A SaaS support lead who just opened a Customerly workspace and can edit their website.

intent.desired_action: Set up live chat on their site
